scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructible from explicit Fourier kernel and elementary graph induction; supporting finite diagnostic checks do not establish the infinite theorem or priority.
scientific_limitations: Fixed half-torus arc, one-dimensional finite integer sets and trace defect; no eigenvalue-by-eigenvalue ordering and no claim for arbitrary spectral bands. Possible unindexed equivalent discrete rearrangement remains a priority risk.
title: Intervals uniquely minimize half-band discrete Fourier trace defect, with a sharp component penalty
